findings.highlight: The man's lips seem like white bone
findings.governingReading: 白蝋 names wax, its lifeless white opposed to the fresh blood at his belly.
findings.explanation: White wax lips become white bone lips.

findings.highlight: The vital tremble of life has already left his throat.
findings.evidenceJa: 喉元よりせりあがる悪寒も既にない
findings.governingReading: 悪寒 is a chill/shudder rising from the throat, no longer felt as his innards change.
findings.explanation: The rising chill already absent becomes the vital tremble of life gone.

findings.evidenceJa: もはや長刀を持つ事もならない
findings.governingReading: 長刀を持つ事もならない locates inability in his ruined body, denying even suicide.
findings.explanation: Unable to hold his sword becomes simply lacking a weapon.

findings.evidenceJa: まったく別の何者かの内臓に変わっていく
findings.governingReading: まったく別の何者かの内臓 identifies the replacement as the internal organs of a different entity being born inside him.
findings.explanation: His organs becoming another being’s organs becomes just morphing into something else.

findings.evidenceJa: 溶けるように高みへ消えていく
findings.governingReading: 溶けるように高みへ消えていく specifies the sound melting away into the heights beneath the moon.
findings.explanation: The cries dissolving upward lose direction and dissolving imagery.
